verdict.rationale: AnyDesk is a remote-desktop product, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows no first-party MCP server or endpoint. The REST API, CLI, Python module and llms.txt are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
